prompt: What was the main reason to move the capital to Rio in 1763?

options.text: Tighter control over the Minas Gerais gold that left through Rio’s port
To escape an epidemic in Salvador

explanation: Rio was the main link between the mines and Europe; the move also helped defend the south of the colony.

prompt: Who moved the capital from Salvador to Rio?

options.text: The Marquis of Pombal, King Joseph I’s minister
